Checking the whole text: the finiteness / large-prime-erasure lemma appears only as a conjecture ('Conjecture: there is a finite set of primes S...'), supported solely by computational exploration; 'Approaches tried' asserts new primes are 'optional' factors 'by computational evidence'; 'Full proof' reads '(Not yet complete.)'. Nowhere is there a general argument that every term divisible by a large prime is dominated by a smaller admissible number with the same small-prime support. So the (F) obligation is indeed not written, and per the rubric conjectures/'to do' items earn no credit. Since finiteness underpins the finite modulus L, the proof is incomplete without it.
